title: Plotter Improvements For Pattern Printing | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive
description:
The new update to our Avatars in CLO 2025.0 allows you to include all pattern information and customize line styles and displays when printing patterns to a plotter.

Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord?utm_campaign=multi_item_banner_JointheOfficialCLODiscord&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=later-linkinbio

markdown_content: # Plotter Improvements for Pattern Printing in Clo 2025.0 This document details the updated features and workflows for exporting pattern layouts to plotters in Clo 2025.0, focusing on print layout options, export settings, and customization of pattern visuals such as seam allowances, outlines, and annotations. --- ## Exporting Patterns Using Print Layout Snapshots This section explains how to export patterns to a plotter using the print layout snapshot feature, emphasizing customization of visible pattern elements like seam allowance, outlines, and annotations. In Clo 2025.0, users can export patterns to a plotter directly from the print layout mode via a snapshot tool. To access this: 1. Switch to **Print Layout** mode from the top toolbar. 2. In the print layout toolbar, locate and select the **Snapshot** icon at the bottom. 3. Create a snapshot of your pattern layout. Key updates to this workflow include enhanced control over which pattern elements are visible in the snapshot: - **Pattern Outlines**: Option to enable or disable, allowing users to show only seam allowances if preferred. - **Seam Allowance**: Can be shown independently or with other elements. - **Baselines, Internal Lines, Graphic Lines, Reference Lines**: These can each be toggled on or off for granular control. - **Symmetrical Instance Lines**: Can be included or excluded. - **Additional Information**: Users can choose to show or hide pattern annotations and nesting header information at the bottom of the snapshot. This includes pattern names and annotations useful for production. After configuring these options, select your desired output scale, typically **1:1**, and save the snapshot. This method provides an efficient way to customize and export pattern visuals tailored for plotting. --- ## Exporting Patterns via File > Export > Plotter This section outlines the alternate export method through the file menu, which offers detailed control over line styles and scaling for plotter output. Another way to export to a plotter in Clo 2025.0 is through: - **File > Export > Plotter** Upon selecting this, a pop-up window appears with advanced export options: - **Notches and Baselines**: These are separated, allowing users to keep notches visible while optionally hiding baselines. - **Graphic Lines and Reference Lines**: Can be toggled on or off. - **Pattern Outlines**: Users can choose whether to include outlines and select their style, such as solid, dotted, or dashed lines. These styles are not previewed in the UI but will be visible in the exported file. Scaling options include: - **Shrink to Fit**: Shrinks the entire pattern and its elements to fit within the layout boundaries, preventing any part from extending beyond the pattern area. - **Actual Size**: Exports the pattern at true scale without resizing. Example usage: - Selecting **Shrink to Fit** ensures all elements scale proportionally within the pattern bounds. - Choosing dotted pattern outlines provides a distinct dashed line style visible in the exported plotter file. Once configured, save the export. The resulting file includes seam allowances, notches, outlines, and any other selected information, ready for plotting. While the preview may appear slightly blurry, the export retains all line styles and annotations clearly. --- ## Summary of Key Features and Benefits - **Flexible Visibility Controls**: Users can selectively show or hide pattern outlines, seam allowances, baselines, notches, internal and graphic lines, and reference lines. - **Line Style Customization**: Ability to choose solid, dotted, or dashed outlines enhances clarity for printing and cutting. - **Multiple Export Methods**: Both snapshot-based and file export workflows accommodate different user preferences. - **Scaling Options**: Shrink to fit and actual size options ensure patterns print correctly without distortion or clipping. - **Additional Annotations**: Nesting headers, pattern names, and annotations can be included to facilitate production and quality control. These improvements provide designers with greater control over their pattern exports, improving precision and efficiency in the plotting and printing process within Clo 2025.0.
